# Decision Owner memo — Worked Example: Estimate — Fermi Magnitude Rebuild (Thermal Energy Storage)

> **To:** Decision Owner\

> **Band (from §6):** MEDIUM

*Derived from §6 and the structured summary of analysis-20260101T000002Z.md; the six sections remain the source of truth.*

In brief: The analysis rebuilds the installed cost of a 5 MWh molten-salt thermal store from its unit-factors and tests whether that store competes with lithium-ion storage (§1, C1).

The question matters because the earlier comparison of GT-5 with GT-6 set a storage-only price against the price of a whole battery system (§5 "Comparing the store's cost with the battery's installed price").

The rebuilt store bracket of $12.0–$34.4/kWh_th explains GT-5 rather than assuming it (C1). Adding the GT-8 power block reverses the four-hour verdict, and the analysis finds that this holds at any conversion efficiency (C1, §6).

Confidence is MEDIUM because GT-7?, the 0.412 conversion factor, is carried rather than read at source (§6). The verdict turns on discharge duration, with break-even somewhere between ~3.7 h and ~18 h, and GT-8 is a large-plant figure far above this system's ~0.5 MW_e scale (C1, §2).

This analysis has no Answer block; its recommendation and the conditions it depends on are stated in §6.
